proof.original_public_outputs: Every original bridge/wrapper/common-FDC output compared without masks, including unconditional io_readdata. Complete real FF next state compared with common arbitrary current state; type/width/clock/reset descriptors agree. No internal combinational cuts.
proof.state_base: Unreset registers and memories have common arbitrary initial contents; source initialization and reset logic unchanged under exact source guards. Bridge/FDC resets independent; reset proofs compare full next-state relation without external protocol assumptions.
proof.memory: Full geometry/init/config guards on every actual memory. Eight actual two-entry arrays completely memory-mapped, without downsizing. Actual FIFO1024x8 retained: all clock/reset/enables/read/write addresses compared, WR_DATA per enabled bit with no reset qualifier. Actual FIFO writes during rst_n0 preserved.
proof.default0: Both new parameters compiled0; all six new retained inputs are arbitrary shared primary inputs, disconnected from bridge output. No relation or protocol assumption on them. Both COMPLETE modes proved.
proof.bridge_contract: Separately proved on actual bridge for every binary initial state/register and input, including invalid state encodings, both modes; actual retained-address negative rejected.
proof.decode_exclusion: Separately proved with exact real source predicates for arbitrary features; FDC excludes all other endpoint candidates and IDE3F6. Actual UART1 overlap negative rejected.
proof.composed_negative: Actual separate core write-address bit2 inverted in both parameter arms. Real SAT mismatch required for active1/default0 and both completion modes; timeout never accepted.
proof.limitations: Defined-input/two-state sampled transitions and stated common-initial-state equivalence coupling. No global machine/arbitration/response-router/CPU/video/ATA equivalence, STA, resource fit, hardware or regression claim.
